review_notes: The file has one theorem, which I read in full. I compared its proof with the other callers of coprimeDispersionGram_eq_poisson_series. Those are LowCoprimeDispersion, PrimeGroupTailCoprimeDispersion, ProfileCommonSmall, StoppedBoundedTotal, HeightCoprimeDispersion and AngularHeightCoprimeDispersion. The Height and Angular versions derive `a ≠ 1` from a different source (the fullPrime norm bounds), so I did not count them as exact duplicates. I did not compile anything. The proposed lemma is untested, and its name and placement are suggestions. The block is short, so the case rests on it being repeated verbatim in five proofs.

have hp : ∀ b ∈ S, primary b ∧ Squarefree b ∧ b ≠ 1 := by
    intro b hb
    refine ⟨(hS b hb).1,(hS b hb).2.1,?_⟩
    intro he
    have hn := (hS b hb).2.2.1
    rw [he,norm_one_eq] at hn
    linarith
findings.problem: The proof rebuilds `primary b ∧ Squarefree b ∧ b ≠ 1` from the dyadic norm window by hand. The argument is: `b = 1` gives `norm b = 1`, which contradicts `Z/2 ≤ norm b` once `Z` is large. The same block is pasted word for word in at least four other proofs. These are `low_coprime_dispersion_height_log_saving`, `primeGroupTail_coprime_dispersion_height_power`, `ProfileControl.smallB_coprime_dispersion_height_power` and `bounded_coprime_dispersion`. The `hA : 0 < A` line from `Z^(3/2) ≤ A` is repeated next to it. Each copy also repeats the surrounding steps: obtain the Poisson-total bound, rewrite with `coprimeDispersionGram_eq_poisson_series`, then close with `fun _ => Finset.Subset.refl _`. A change to the hypotheses, such as the `Z` lower bound or the shape of the window, has to be made in every copy.
findings.proposed_change:
Add a lemma near `coprimeDispersionGram_eq_poisson_series` in CoprimePoissonSeries.lean, which all five files import (StoppedBoundedTotal imports it directly). Suggested statement:
`lemma primary_squarefree_ne_one_of_norm_window {S : Finset Eisenstein} {Z : ℝ} (hZ : 2 < Z) (hS : ∀ b ∈ S, primary b ∧ Squarefree b ∧ Z/2 ≤ norm b ∧ norm b ≤ Z) : ∀ b ∈ S, primary b ∧ Squarefree b ∧ b ≠ 1`.
Proof: take the body of the current `hp` block, using `hZ` for the final `linarith`.
Use in the target: `have hp := primary_squarefree_ne_one_of_norm_window (by linarith : 2 < (Z:ℝ)) hS`, with `hZ : 4 ≤ (Z:ℝ)` in scope.
Use in `bounded_coprime_dispersion`: `have hp := primary_squarefree_ne_one_of_norm_window (by linarith : 2 < N) hS`, with `hN : 65536 ≤ N`.
The Low, PrimeGroupTail and ProfileCommonSmall proofs change the same way, and each can drop its local `hp` block. Optionally also factor `0 < A` from `Z^(3/2) ≤ A` into a one-line lemma.
findings.benefit: This removes about seven duplicated lines from each of five proofs. The window-implies-`b ≠ 1` argument then lives in one named place. Each wrapper reduces to the Poisson-total call and the actual estimate. Readers see why `b ≠ 1` holds as a single lemma statement, and any change to the window shape or the `Z` threshold is made once.
